title: Central Bank Holds Rates at 19%/20%; Raises 2026 Inflation Forecast to 16–17%
detail: The Central Bank of Egypt's Monetary Policy Committee held the overnight deposit rate at 19% and the overnight lending rate at 20% at its May 21 meeting — the second consecutive hold. More significantly, the CBE raised its 2026 inflation forecast to 16–17%, up sharply from a prior estimate of approximately 11%, citing regional uncertainty stemming from the Gaza conflict, energy price pressures, and currency volatility. The CBE expects inflation to accelerate through Q3 2026 before gradually declining toward its medium-term target range. Egypt had achieved a multi-year low of 11.9% inflation in January 2026, down from a 40% peak in 2023, but the revised forecast signals that disinflation has stalled. The hold decision aligns with IMF EFF program benchmarks and comes as the 7th review mission is active in Cairo.

title: Agiba/Eni Strike Largest Western Desert Gas Discovery in 15 Years: ~330 Billion Cubic Feet
detail: Agiba Petroleum — a joint venture between Egypt's state oil company EGPC and Italy's Eni — announced the largest natural gas discovery in Egypt's Western Desert in 15 years. The find contains approximately 330 billion cubic feet (bcf) of gas plus an estimated 10 million barrels of condensate and oil, totaling roughly 70 million barrels of oil equivalent (BOE). The discovery comes as a significant boost to Egypt's energy security and export potential, particularly as the country works to restore its position as a natural gas export hub following production declines since 2021. The find reinforces Egypt's role in the Eastern Mediterranean energy landscape, where the country is simultaneously in active discussions with ExxonMobil and QatarEnergy about routing Cyprus offshore gas through Egyptian liquefaction infrastructure.
